methods_quotes.q: Differences in ED visits among various OPRs and benzodiazepines were tested using two-sided t tests.
Risk ratios and associated 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated to compare drug-related deaths caused by various OPRs and benzodiazepines.
Estimates were suppressed if the relative standard error was >50% or if the estimate was based on fewer than 30 cases.
Per standard DAWN ME suppression rules, counts of deaths that were less than four but greater than zero were suppressed
Poststratified weights were applied to the data from participating hospitals.
